about: A Zork-like underground dungeon. You return as a proven adventurer for a final test set by an old wizard. It has a lantern, a stuck Elvish sword, shadowy lands and grues.

done.why: I sampled a handful of rooms and one death in a short session, and no goal pulled me on.

ending.what: None reached. I died once to a grue and was revived in a cell.

moments.note: Greeting the footsteps got a reply: they stopped to listen, then went on.
Walking in the dark killed me at once, but the death scene with the old man was vivid and gave a reason to come back.
Asking politely for the lantern to follow me was not understood.

wished: Pull the sword with some trick or help.
Clear the rockfall to the east.

lines.line: Oh, no! A lurking grue slithered into the room and devoured you!
lines.why: Classic death, followed by a good respawn scene.

lines.line: It will not be cleared today.
lines.why: The blocked passage gets a specific, in-voice refusal.

fun.why: Pleasant and familiar, but I saw little of it.

engagement.why: The footsteps and the sword are hooks, but I left early.

difficulty.why: Fair. The darkness death was my own doing.

interestingness.why: A mix of old and new details, such as the dream and the wizard.

prose.why: Clean and atmospheric, with in-voice refusals.
